business_summary.text: Sudeep Pharma is a specialty chemicals company producing mineral-based excipients and ingredients for pharma, food and nutrition, and specialty ingredient markets, and is building a battery-materials (iron phosphate) business through Sudeep Advanced Materials.

call_points.text: NSS is targeted to reach margins similar to core specialty ingredients by FY28.
Sudeep Advanced Materials Phase 1 commissioning targeted for April 2027; long-lead equipment deliveries complete this October.
Navsari greenfield: FDA approval expected this quarter, supplies to start Q3; five food-nutra customers approving the site.
Phosphate demand exceeds current capacity, giving visibility for the balance of FY27.
Bisglycinate Q1 sales already surpassed the whole of FY26; two large North American customers approved.
Battery materials: 7 customers completed validation and are in active off-take talks; two binding agreements targeted later this year.
Phosphoric acid prices rose ~50% in Q1 on higher sulfur; pass-through expected to largely offset in Q2.
NSS faces a customer scaling down operations in Ireland due to energy costs; FY27 may be flattish with single-digit growth.
Asset turns at scale for battery and greenfield expected at 2.7-3x.
**Pharma/food capacity target:** existing business can reach ₹1,000–1,200 Cr revenue without extra capex post-greenfield commissioning.
**Long-term capex:** full 100,000 MT battery material capacity expansion targeted at ₹600 Cr total outlay.
**Revenue potential:** 100,000 MT battery material capacity offers ₹1,600–1,800 Cr revenue potential at peak utilization.
**Battery purchase orders:** received ~700 MT of commercial purchase orders over the last month.
**New customer approvals:** secured ~51 new customer approvals in FY26 to drive upcoming growth.
**High-margin expansion:** launching AbsorBis bisglycinate range targeting a global market of ~$1 billion.
Secured commercial purchase orders of 700 MT volume in recent months for battery materials.
Implemented necessary price revisions with customers to offset sharp rise in phosphoric and sulphuric acid prices.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹182.34 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹48.88 Cr.
Sudeep Pharma presented its Q4FY26 presentation highlighting ₹642.3 Cr FY26 revenue and groundbreaking of its ₹300 Cr battery materials plant at Dahej.
Sudeep Pharma Limited’s **Mehta Ashwinbhai Dimple Mehta** shared the earnings call audio recording on 22 May 2026 via the company website.
Sudeep Pharma hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call, outlining guidance for ₹1,000-1,200 Cr core revenue capacity and execution updates on its Dahej battery materials facility.

On 5 August 2026, Sudeep Pharma held its Q1FY27 earnings call, reporting 27% YoY revenue growth to ₹158.3 Cr and guiding to 37-38% EBITDA margins, with battery-materials Phase 1 commissioning targeted for April 2027.
Received Gujarat FDA approval for its new 51,200 MT greenfield pharma facility at 179 Nandesari, with commercial supplies expected in H2 FY27.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹196.7 Cr (+20.9% YoY), net profit ₹51.81 Cr (+10.8% YoY).
Sudeep Pharma reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹196.7 Cr (+21% YoY) and PAT of ₹51.8 Cr (+11% YoY), backed by strong demand and progress on greenfield expansions.
Audio recording of earnings call held on 29th October 2026 uploaded on company website.
